content.text:
Resubmitted and accepted.

**Repair made:** the inserted licence now carries its clause number in the operative text — "10.5 License to Developed Software. M&I grants Customer a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense the Developed Software for Customer's business." — so the § 17.2 carve-out "Except as provided in Section 10.5" resolves to a real, numbered provision rather than a dangling reference.

**Unchanged and intact:**
- § 10.4's M&I ownership sentence, its right to make Developed Software available to other customers, and the refund/credit mechanic are preserved verbatim.
- § 17.2 keeps every original word, with only a five-word conforming prefix inserted.
- §§ 17.1 and 17.4 (Customer Data ownership and confidentiality) are untouched and continue to satisfy the Customer Data element.

**Level:** fallback — Vendor retains ownership of its programs and know-how; we obtain the perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free use/modify/sublicense rights for our business. Preferred (assignment of deliverables plus an express embedded-IP licence) is not claimed, as it would require collateral rewrites of M&I's ownership, resale and refund machinery.
